rdram_size.source: hosts/n64recomp/RUNTIME.md N64R_PAK: the host's console is the 8 MB Expansion Pak one; osMemSize (0x80000318) only receives it

rsp_audio.source: versions/us-rev1/splat.yaml segment rsp_audio_code (rom 0xDFE30); the boot microcode (segment rsp_boot, osSpTaskLoad's ucode_boot) loads the audio microcode text to the IMEM offset its `addi rt,$zero,imm` / `jr rt` pair names, read from the ROM, so every jal/jump-table address is text offset + that offset
